items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: So playing with him, it’s funny, I just pulled out my Maynard Ferguson tour jacket from 1986.

ctx.x: So when he died it was like oh my God, man, how can Maynard be gone? So playing with him, it’s funny, I just pulled out my Maynard Ferguson tour jacket from 1986. I pulled it out today because I’m so much thinner now that it fits me again. I used to be a 39 long, as far as my sports coat. And then I went up to a 48 long at my heaviest. I don’t know what I am now but I’m probably a 44 now. But that jacket was always big on me back then. And I put it on today and it fits, and I was like oh wow. That’s funny that…
Wasn’t a big part of his success as a trumpet player having something to do with his breathing?
